doc: /* dynamic_rate.c - compute per-night rate with weekend and peak-season uplift */ #include <stdio.h> #include "travel_db.h" int nightly_rate(const char *hotel_id, const char *room_type, const char *date, double *out_rate) { double base = 0.0; if (db_lookup_base_rate(hotel_id, room_type, &base) != DB_OK) return -1; struct tm tm_date; if (parse_iso_date(date, &tm_date) != 0) return -2; int weekend = (tm_date.tm_wday == 0 || tm_date.tm_wday == 6); if (weekend) base *= 1.15; int peak = 0; if (db_is_peak_season(hotel_id, date, &peak) != DB_OK) return -3; if (peak) base *= 1.25; *out_rate = base; return 0; }

doc: /** * Handles a holiday request with entitlement and cover checks. */ public class HolidayRequestService { private final LeaveEntitlementRepository entitlements; private final TeamCoverPolicy coverPolicy; private final LeaveRequestRepository requests; public HolidayRequestService(LeaveEntitlementRepository entitlements, TeamCoverPolicy coverPolicy, LeaveRequestRepository requests) { this.entitlements = entitlements; this.coverPolicy = coverPolicy; this.requests = requests; } public LeaveRequest submit(String employeeId, LocalDate from, LocalDate to) { int days = (int) (to.toEpochDay() - from.toEpochDay()) + 1; if (entitlements.remainingDays(employeeId) < days) { throw new InsufficientLeaveException(employeeId, days); } if (!coverPolicy.hasAdequateCover(employeeId, from, to)) { throw new CoverUnavailableException(employeeId, from, to); } return requests.save(LeaveRequest.pending(employeeId, from, to, days)); } }

doc: /** * Orchestrates a monthly payroll run across a pay group. */ public class MonthlyPayrollRunner { private final EmployeeRepository employees; private final GrossPayCalculator grossPay; private final DeductionCalculator deductions; private final PayslipRepository payslips; public MonthlyPayrollRunner(EmployeeRepository employees, GrossPayCalculator grossPay, DeductionCalculator deductions, PayslipRepository payslips) { this.employees = employees; this.grossPay = grossPay; this.deductions = deductions; this.payslips = payslips; } public PayrollRunResult run(String payGroupId, YearMonth month) { List<Employee> members = employees.findActiveInPayGroup(payGroupId); PayrollRunResult result = new PayrollRunResult(month); for (Employee e : members) { PayPeriod period = PayPeriod.of(month, e); var gross = grossPay.compute(period, e.getCompensation()); var ded = deductions.compute(period, e.getCompensation()); Payslip slip = Payslip.create(e, period, gross, ded); payslips.save(slip); result.add(slip); } return result; } }

doc: /* bank_payment_file.c - produce BACS-style payment file for a payroll run */ #include <stdio.h> #include "payroll_db.h" int write_payment_file(const char *pay_month, const char *path) { FILE *out = fopen(path, "w"); if (!out) return -1; fprintf(out, "employee_ref,sort_code,account_number,amount\n"); db_cursor_t *cur = NULL; if (db_open_payslip_cursor(&cur, pay_month) != DB_OK) { fclose(out); return -2; } payslip_row_t row; int lines = 0; while (db_payslip_cursor_next(cur, &row) == DB_OK) { if (row.on_unpaid_leave) continue; if (row.net_pay <= 0) continue; fprintf(out, "%s,%s,%s,%.2f\n", row.employee_ref, row.sort_code, row.account_number, row.net_pay); lines++; } db_close_cursor(cur); fclose(out); return lines; }

doc: /** * Rolls up stock value per SKU using on-hand quantity and standard cost. */ public class InventoryValuationService { private final StockRepository stock; private final CostRepository costs; public InventoryValuationService(StockRepository stock, CostRepository costs) { this.stock = stock; this.costs = costs; } public ValuationReport valueAll() { List<String> skus = stock.distinctSkus(); BigDecimal grandTotal = BigDecimal.ZERO; ValuationReport report = new ValuationReport(); for (String sku : skus) { int qty = stock.totalOnHand(sku); BigDecimal cost = costs.standardCostFor(sku); BigDecimal value = cost.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(qty)).setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP); report.add(new SkuValuation(sku, qty, cost, value)); grandTotal = grandTotal.add(value); } report.setTotal(grandTotal); return report; } }

doc: /** * Computes a SHA-256 digest while streaming a file to storage. */ public class ChecksummingStorage { private final BlobStore blobStore; public ChecksummingStorage(BlobStore blobStore) { this.blobStore = blobStore; } public StoredFile store(InputStream in, String fileName) throws java.io.IOException { MessageDigest digest = sha256(); DigestInputStream dis = new DigestInputStream(in, digest); String key = blobStore.write(fileName, dis); String checksum = toHex(digest.digest()); return new StoredFile(key, checksum, blobStore.sizeOf(key)); } private MessageDigest sha256() { try { return MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256"); } catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException e) { throw new IllegalStateException("SHA-256 unavailable", e); } } private String toHex(byte[] bytes) { return java.util.HexFormat.of().formatHex(bytes); } }

doc: /** * Computes average soil moisture over a window, skipping faulty readings. */ public class AverageSoilMoistureCalculator { private final SensorReadingRepository readings; public AverageSoilMoistureCalculator(SensorReadingRepository readings) { this.readings = readings; } public double average(String fieldId, Instant from, Instant to) { List<SensorReading> window = readings.findBetween(fieldId, SensorKind.SOIL_MOISTURE, from, to); double sum = 0.0; int count = 0; for (SensorReading r : window) { if (r.isFaulty()) continue; sum += r.getValue(); count++; } if (count == 0) { throw new NoReadingsException(fieldId, from, to); } return sum / count; } }

doc: /** * Estimates a monthly mortgage repayment for a listing. */ public class MortgageEstimateCalculator { private final BigDecimal annualInterestRate; private final int termYears; public MortgageEstimateCalculator(BigDecimal annualInterestRate, int termYears) { this.annualInterestRate = annualInterestRate; this.termYears = termYears; } public BigDecimal monthlyRepayment(BigDecimal askingPrice, BigDecimal deposit) { BigDecimal principal = askingPrice.subtract(deposit); if (principal.signum() <= 0) { return BigDecimal.ZERO; } double r = annualInterestRate.doubleValue() / 100.0 / 12.0; int n = termYears * 12; double payment = principal.doubleValue() * r / (1 - Math.pow(1 + r, -n)); return BigDecimal.valueOf(payment).setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP); } }

doc: /** * Computes free slots for an attendee between two instants. */ public class FreeSlotCalculator { private final AppointmentRepository appointments; private final WorkingHoursPolicy hours; public FreeSlotCalculator(AppointmentRepository appointments, WorkingHoursPolicy hours) { this.appointments = appointments; this.hours = hours; } public List<Slot> freeSlots(String attendeeId, Instant from, Instant to, Duration duration) { List<Slot> result = new ArrayList<>(); for (Slot working : hours.windowsFor(attendeeId, from, to)) { for (Slot candidate : splitByExisting(working, appointments.findByAttendee(attendeeId, working.getStart(), working.getEnd()))) { if (!candidate.getDuration().minus(duration).isNegative()) { result.add(candidate); } } } return result; } private List<Slot> splitByExisting(Slot working, List<Appointment> existing) { List<Slot> parts = new ArrayList<>(); Instant cursor = working.getStart(); existing.sort(java.util.Comparator.comparing(Appointment::getStart)); for (Appointment a : existing) { if (a.getStart().isAfter(cursor)) parts.add(new Slot(cursor, a.getStart())); if (a.getEnd().isAfter(cursor)) cursor = a.getEnd(); } if (cursor.isBefore(working.getEnd())) parts.add(new Slot(cursor, working.getEnd())); return parts; } }

doc: /** * Verifies a one-time code sent to the voter's registered channel. */ public class OtpVerificationService { private static final Duration VALIDITY = Duration.ofMinutes(5); private static final int MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3; private final OtpRepository otps; public OtpVerificationService(OtpRepository otps) { this.otps = otps; } public boolean verify(String voterId, String code, Instant now) { Otp otp = otps.latestFor(voterId).orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalStateException("No code issued")); if (now.isAfter(otp.getIssuedAt().plus(VALIDITY))) { throw new ExpiredCodeException(voterId); } if (otp.getAttempts() >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) { throw new TooManyAttemptsException(voterId); } if (!otp.getCode().equals(code)) { otps.incrementAttempts(otp.getId()); return false; } otps.markConsumed(otp.getId()); return true; } }

doc: /* admission_bed.c - allocate next free bed in a ward, or fail if none available */ #include <stdio.h> #include <string.h> #include "hospital_db.h" int allocate_bed(const char *patient_id, const char *ward_id, char *out_bed_code, size_t out_len) { bed_cursor_t *cur = NULL; if (db_open_free_bed_cursor(&cur, ward_id) != DB_OK) { return -1; } bed_row_t row; int allocated = 0; while (db_bed_cursor_next(cur, &row) == DB_OK) { snprintf(out_bed_code, out_len, "%s", row.bed_code); allocated = 1; break; /* cursor is ordered by bed_code ascending */ } db_close_cursor(cur); if (!allocated) { fprintf(stderr, "ward %s has no free bed\n", ward_id); return -2; } char now[32]; db_current_timestamp(now, sizeof(now)); return db_insert_bed_allocation(patient_id, ward_id, out_bed_code, now); }

doc: /** * Splits the total between insurance coverage and patient payment. */ public class DispensingChargeCalculator { private final PricingService pricing; private final CoveragePolicy coverage; public DispensingChargeCalculator(PricingService pricing, CoveragePolicy coverage) { this.pricing = pricing; this.coverage = coverage; } public DispenseCharge calculate(List<DispensedItem> items, String schemeCode) { BigDecimal retail = items.stream() .map(i -> pricing.retailPrice(i.getMedicineCode()).multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(i.getQuantity()))) .reduce(BigDecimal.ZERO, BigDecimal::add); BigDecimal covered = coverage.coveredPortion(schemeCode, retail); BigDecimal payable = retail.subtract(covered).max(BigDecimal.ZERO); return new DispenseCharge(retail, covered, payable.setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP)); } }

doc: /** * Scores how well a candidate's skills match a posting's requirements. */ public class SkillMatchScorer { private final PostingRepository postings; public SkillMatchScorer(PostingRepository postings) { this.postings = postings; } public BigDecimal score(String postingId, CandidateProfile candidate) { Posting p = postings.require(postingId); Map<String, BigDecimal> weights = p.getSkillWeights(); BigDecimal totalWeight = weights.values().stream().reduce(BigDecimal.ZERO, BigDecimal::add); if (totalWeight.signum() == 0) { return BigDecimal.ZERO; } BigDecimal matched = BigDecimal.ZERO; for (Map.Entry<String, BigDecimal> e : weights.entrySet()) { if (candidate.getSkills().contains(e.getKey())) { matched = matched.add(e.getValue()); } } return matched.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(100)) .divide(totalWeight, 2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP); } }

doc: #include <stdbool.h> #include <stddef.h> #include <string.h> /* Canonicalize ASCII references received from clinical note terminals. */ bool normalize_clinical_note_ref(const char *src, char *dst, size_t cap) { if (!src || !dst) return false; size_t first = 0, last = strlen(src); while (first < last && src[first] == ' ') ++first; while (last > first && src[last - 1] == ' ') --last; size_t size = last - first; if (!size || cap <= size) return false; /* memmove allows source and destination to overlap. */ memmove(dst, src + first, size); for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) { unsigned char ch = (unsigned char)dst[i]; if (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') dst[i] = (char)(ch - 'a' + 'A'); } dst[size] = '\0'; return true; }

doc: #include <stdbool.h> #include <stddef.h> #include <string.h> /* Canonicalize ASCII references received from catalog entry terminals. */ bool normalize_catalog_entry_ref(const char *src, char *dst, size_t cap) { if (!src || !dst) return false; size_t first = 0, last = strlen(src); while (first < last && src[first] == ' ') ++first; while (last > first && src[last - 1] == ' ') --last; size_t size = last - first; if (!size || cap <= size) return false; /* memmove allows source and destination to overlap. */ memmove(dst, src + first, size); for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) { unsigned char ch = (unsigned char)dst[i]; if (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') dst[i] = (char)(ch - 'a' + 'A'); } dst[size] = '\0'; return true; }

doc: #include <stdbool.h> #include <stddef.h> #include <string.h> /* Canonicalize ASCII references received from library branch terminals. */ bool normalize_library_branch_ref(const char *src, char *dst, size_t cap) { if (!src || !dst) return false; size_t first = 0, last = strlen(src); while (first < last && src[first] == ' ') ++first; while (last > first && src[last - 1] == ' ') --last; size_t size = last - first; if (!size || cap <= size) return false; /* memmove allows source and destination to overlap. */ memmove(dst, src + first, size); for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) { unsigned char ch = (unsigned char)dst[i]; if (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') dst[i] = (char)(ch - 'a' + 'A'); } dst[size] = '\0'; return true; }

doc: #include <stdbool.h> #include <stddef.h> #include <string.h> /* Canonicalize ASCII references received from employee profile terminals. */ bool normalize_employee_profile_ref(const char *src, char *dst, size_t cap) { if (!src || !dst) return false; size_t first = 0, last = strlen(src); while (first < last && src[first] == ' ') ++first; while (last > first && src[last - 1] == ' ') --last; size_t size = last - first; if (!size || cap <= size) return false; /* memmove allows source and destination to overlap. */ memmove(dst, src + first, size); for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) { unsigned char ch = (unsigned char)dst[i]; if (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') dst[i] = (char)(ch - 'a' + 'A'); } dst[size] = '\0'; return true; }

doc: #include <stdbool.h> #include <stddef.h> #include <string.h> /* Canonicalize ASCII references received from shipping carton terminals. */ bool normalize_shipping_carton_ref(const char *src, char *dst, size_t cap) { if (!src || !dst) return false; size_t first = 0, last = strlen(src); while (first < last && src[first] == ' ') ++first; while (last > first && src[last - 1] == ' ') --last; size_t size = last - first; if (!size || cap <= size) return false; /* memmove allows source and destination to overlap. */ memmove(dst, src + first, size); for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) { unsigned char ch = (unsigned char)dst[i]; if (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') dst[i] = (char)(ch - 'a' + 'A'); } dst[size] = '\0'; return true; }

doc: #include <stdbool.h> #include <stddef.h> #include <string.h> /* Canonicalize ASCII references received from stock batch terminals. */ bool normalize_stock_batch_ref(const char *src, char *dst, size_t cap) { if (!src || !dst) return false; size_t first = 0, last = strlen(src); while (first < last && src[first] == ' ') ++first; while (last > first && src[last - 1] == ' ') --last; size_t size = last - first; if (!size || cap <= size) return false; /* memmove allows source and destination to overlap. */ memmove(dst, src + first, size); for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) { unsigned char ch = (unsigned char)dst[i]; if (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') dst[i] = (char)(ch - 'a' + 'A'); } dst[size] = '\0'; return true; }

doc: #include <stdbool.h> #include <stddef.h> #include <string.h> /* Canonicalize ASCII references received from claim terminals. */ bool normalize_claim_ref(const char *src, char *dst, size_t cap) { if (!src || !dst) return false; size_t first = 0, last = strlen(src); while (first < last && src[first] == ' ') ++first; while (last > first && src[last - 1] == ' ') --last; size_t size = last - first; if (!size || cap <= size) return false; /* memmove allows source and destination to overlap. */ memmove(dst, src + first, size); for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) { unsigned char ch = (unsigned char)dst[i]; if (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') dst[i] = (char)(ch - 'a' + 'A'); } dst[size] = '\0'; return true; }

doc: #include <stdbool.h> #include <stddef.h> #include <string.h> /* Canonicalize ASCII references received from repair estimate terminals. */ bool normalize_repair_estimate_ref(const char *src, char *dst, size_t cap) { if (!src || !dst) return false; size_t first = 0, last = strlen(src); while (first < last && src[first] == ' ') ++first; while (last > first && src[last - 1] == ' ') --last; size_t size = last - first; if (!size || cap <= size) return false; /* memmove allows source and destination to overlap. */ memmove(dst, src + first, size); for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) { unsigned char ch = (unsigned char)dst[i]; if (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') dst[i] = (char)(ch - 'a' + 'A'); } dst[size] = '\0'; return true; }

doc: #include <stdbool.h> #include <stddef.h> #include <string.h> /* Canonicalize ASCII references received from digest subscription terminals. */ bool normalize_digest_subscription_ref(const char *src, char *dst, size_t cap) { if (!src || !dst) return false; size_t first = 0, last = strlen(src); while (first < last && src[first] == ' ') ++first; while (last > first && src[last - 1] == ' ') --last; size_t size = last - first; if (!size || cap <= size) return false; /* memmove allows source and destination to overlap. */ memmove(dst, src + first, size); for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) { unsigned char ch = (unsigned char)dst[i]; if (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') dst[i] = (char)(ch - 'a' + 'A'); } dst[size] = '\0'; return true; }

doc: #include <stdbool.h> #include <stddef.h> #include <string.h> /* Canonicalize ASCII references received from archive job terminals. */ bool normalize_archive_job_ref(const char *src, char *dst, size_t cap) { if (!src || !dst) return false; size_t first = 0, last = strlen(src); while (first < last && src[first] == ' ') ++first; while (last > first && src[last - 1] == ' ') --last; size_t size = last - first; if (!size || cap <= size) return false; /* memmove allows source and destination to overlap. */ memmove(dst, src + first, size); for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) { unsigned char ch = (unsigned char)dst[i]; if (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') dst[i] = (char)(ch - 'a' + 'A'); } dst[size] = '\0'; return true; }

doc: #include <stdbool.h> #include <stddef.h> #include <string.h> /* Canonicalize ASCII references received from resource booking terminals. */ bool normalize_resource_booking_ref(const char *src, char *dst, size_t cap) { if (!src || !dst) return false; size_t first = 0, last = strlen(src); while (first < last && src[first] == ' ') ++first; while (last > first && src[last - 1] == ' ') --last; size_t size = last - first; if (!size || cap <= size) return false; /* memmove allows source and destination to overlap. */ memmove(dst, src + first, size); for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) { unsigned char ch = (unsigned char)dst[i]; if (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') dst[i] = (char)(ch - 'a' + 'A'); } dst[size] = '\0'; return true; }

query: Normalize a creator profile reference by removing surrounding ASCII spaces and uppercasing ASCII letters, rejecting empty references or insufficient output space.
doc: #include <stdbool.h> #include <stddef.h> #include <string.h> /* Canonicalize ASCII references received from creator profile terminals. */ bool normalize_creator_profile_ref(const char *src, char *dst, size_t cap) { if (!src || !dst) return false; size_t first = 0, last = strlen(src); while (first < last && src[first] == ' ') ++first; while (last > first && src[last - 1] == ' ') --last; size_t size = last - first; if (!size || cap <= size) return false; /* memmove allows source and destination to overlap. */ memmove(dst, src + first, size); for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) { unsigned char ch = (unsigned char)dst[i]; if (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') dst[i] = (char)(ch - 'a' + 'A'); } dst[size] = '\0'; return true; }

query: Normalize a creator profile reference by removing surrounding ASCII spaces and uppercasing ASCII letters, rejecting empty references or insufficient output space.
doc: #include <stdbool.h> #include <stddef.h> #include <string.h> /* Produce a lowercase reference for a case-insensitive search index. */ bool fold_reference(const char *src, char *dst, size_t cap) { if (!src || !dst || strlen(src) >= cap) return false; memmove(dst, src, strlen(src) + 1); for (size_t i = 0; dst[i]; ++i) if (dst[i] >= 'A' && dst[i] <= 'Z') dst[i] += 'a' - 'A'; return true; }

" + "where id = ? and open_items + cast(? as bigint) >= 0", delta, id, delta); if (changed != 1) { throw new IllegalStateException("Record missing or count would become negative"); } } }
